name: NavFolders
conditions: Free submission requires adding a NavFolders badge (dofollow backlink) to your website footer BEFORE submitting — 'We verify the backlink when you click the free submit button; without it, your product will not enter review'
Free plan: reviewed and listed within 72 hours, no customer support, link includes 'backlink maintenance'
requirements: Broad product scope: tools across image, video, productivity, AI, SaaS, games, business, education categories, with platform tags (Web, iOS, Android, Mac, Windows)
preparation: NavFolders badge (Dark/Light/Transparent variants provided on the pricing page) embedded in your footer before hitting submit
Product name, URL, description, category and platform tags, logo/screenshot
Plan choice: Free $0 / Pro $9.9 (>=3 dofollow links, publish on your chosen day, featured placement, support) / Sponsor $19.9 per week (site-wide promotion, one ad per period)
workflow: Embed the badge if going free
Create an account via Google/GitHub or /auth/register
Open /submit, pick the plan, fill in product details
Free listings enter review and are listed within ~72 hours; Pro can publish immediately and schedule the publish day
watchFor: Badge verification happens at click time on the free submit button — the badge must already be deployed
'3 dofollow links' on free/Pro refers to links inside the listing package — count does not equal DR quality
Sponsor is weekly recurring ($19.9/week), not one-time
Badge must stay live ('Permanent link with backlink maintenance')
countsAsLive: Product detail page on navfolders.com reachable from Search/Category browsing with its platform and category tags
unknowns: Exact form fields behind the sign-in wall
Whether the free listing itself is dofollow or only the '3 links' bundle
